body: On the cluster-routing nitpick, declining for the same reason as the PR body: replica lag is not reproducible on a single node, and a primary-replica cluster harness in CI is a heavy lift for a check whose correctness rests on a routing rule (scripts never take the replica path). If go-redis ever changes that rule, no lag simulation would catch it anyway — the suite would need the routing assertion itself.
